 26473                                  ;Break   <DskRdBufScan -- Disk Read Buffer Scan>
 26474                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 26475                                  ;
 26476                                  ; Procedure Name : DskRdBufScan
 26477                                  ;
 26478                                  ; Inputs:
 26479                                  ;       CX = # of contiguous sectors read. (These constitute a block of
 26480                                  ;            sectors, also termed an "Extent".)
 26481                                  ;       [HIGH_SECTOR]:DX = physical sector # of first sector in extent.
 26482                                  ;       [TEMP_VAR2]:[TEMP_VAR] = Transfer address (destination data address).
 26483                                  ;       ES:BP -> Drive Parameter Block (DPB).
 26484                                  ;
 26485                                  ; Function:
 26486                                  ;	The Buffer Queue is scanned: the contents of any dirty buffers are
 26487                                  ;	"read" into the transfer memory block, so that the transfer memory
 26488                                  ;	reflects the most recent data.
 26489                                  ;
 26490                                  ; Outputs:
 26491                                  ;       Transfer memory updated as required.
 26492                                  ;
 26493                                  ; Uses:
 26494                                  ;       DS,AX,BX,CX,SI,DI destroyed.
 26495                                  ;       SS override for all global variables.
 26496                                  ;
 26497                                  ; Notes:
 26498                                  ;       FIRST_BUFF_ADDR is set-up to contain the LAST buffer to check, rather
 26499                                  ;	than the FIRST.
 26500                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 26501                                  ;M039: Created
 26502                                  
 26503                                  ; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 26504                                  ; DOSCODE:78F0h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 26505                                  
 26506                                  ; 18/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 26507                                  ; DOSCODE:78DCh (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 26508                                  
 26509                                  ; 09/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 26510                                  ; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:8313h
 26511                                  
 26512                                  ;procedure DskRdBufScan,NEAR
 26513                                  ;
 26514                                  ;ASSUME  DS:NOTHING
 26515                                  
 26516                                  DskRdBufScan:
 26517 000042D1 36833E[7100]00          	cmp	word [ss:DirtyBufferCount],0 ; Any dirty buffers?
 26518 000042D7 743C                    	je	short bufx		     ; -no, skip all work.
 26519                                  
 26520 000042D9 368B1E[0706]            	mov     bx,[ss:HIGH_SECTOR]
 26521 000042DE 89DE                    	mov     si,bx
 26522 000042E0 01D1                    	add     cx,dx
 26523 000042E2 83D600                  	adc     si,0
 26524                                  
 26525 000042E5 E8CC25                  	call	GETCURHEAD		;DS:DI -> 1st buf in queue.
 26526                                  	;mov	ax,[di+2]
 26527 000042E8 8B4502                  	mov     ax,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_prev]
 26528 000042EB 36A3[7E11]              	mov     [ss:FIRST_BUFF_ADDR],ax
 26529                                  		
 26530                                  	; 18/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 26531                                  	;;mov	al,[es:bp+0]
 26532                                  	;mov	al,[es:bp+DPB.DRIVE]
 26533                                  	; 15/12/2022
 26534 000042EF 268A4600                	mov	al,[es:bp]
 26535                                  
 26536                                  ;       BX:DX = Extent start.
 26537                                  ;       SI:CX = Extent end + 1.
 26538                                  ;          AL = Drive #.
 26539                                  ;       DS:DI-> 1st buffer in queue.
 26540                                  ;[FIRST_BUFF_ADDR] = Address offset of last buffer in queue.
 26541                                  
 26542                                  bufq:
 26543                                  	;cmp	al,[di+4]
 26544 000042F3 3A4504                  	cmp     al,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_ID] ;Same drive?
 26545 000042F6 7514                    	jne	short bufq1        	;  -no, jump.
 26546                                  
 26547                                  ;       Cmp32   bx,dx,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector+2]>,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector]>
 26548                                  ;       ja	short bufq1		;Jump if Extent start > buffer sector.
 26549                                  
 26550                                  	;cmp	bx,[di+8]
 26551 000042F8 3B5D08                  	cmp	bx,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector+2]
 26552 000042FB 7503                    	jne	short bufq01
 26553                                  	;cmp	dx,[di+6]
 26554 000042FD 3B5506                  	cmp	dx,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector]
 26555                                  bufq01:
 26556 00004300 770A                    	ja	short bufq1
 26557                                  
 26558                                  ;       Cmp32   si,cx,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector+2]>,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector]>
 26559                                  ;       ja	short bufq2		;Jump if Extent end >= buffer sector.
 26560                                  
 26561                                  	;cmp	si,[di+8]
 26562 00004302 3B7508                  	cmp	si,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector+2]
 26563 00004305 7503                    	jne	short bufq02
 26564                                  	;cmp	cx,[di+6]
 26565 00004307 3B4D06                  	cmp	cx,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector]
 26566                                  bufq02:
 26567 0000430A 770A                    	ja	short bufq2
 26568                                  bufq1:	
 26569 0000430C 363B3E[7E11]            	cmp     di,[ss:FIRST_BUFF_ADDR]	;Scanned entire buffer queue?
 26570 00004311 8B3D                    	mov	di,[di]
 26571                                  	;mov	di,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_next] ; Set-up for next buffer.
 26572 00004313 75DE                    	jne	short bufq		; -no, do next buffer
 26573                                  bufx:
 26574 00004315 C3                      	retn				;Exit.
 26575                                  
 26576                                  ;       Buffer's sector is in Extent: if it is dirty, copy its contents to
 26577                                  ;	transfer memory; otherwise, just re-position it in the buffer queue
 26578                                  ;       as MRU (Most Recently Used).
 26579                                  
 26580                                  bufq2:
 26581 00004316 50                      	push	ax
 26582                                  	;test	byte [di+5],40h
 26583 00004317 F6450540                	test	byte [di+BUFFINFO.buf_flags],buf_dirty ;Buffer dirty?
 26584 0000431B 7430                    	jz	short bufq3                    ; -no, jump.
 26585                                  
 26586                                  ;       SaveReg <cx,dx,si,di,es>
 26587 0000431D 51                      	push	cx
 26588 0000431E 52                      	push	dx
 26589 0000431F 56                      	push	si
 26590 00004320 57                      	push	di
 26591 00004321 06                      	push	es
 26592                                  
 26593 00004322 89D0                    	mov     ax,dx
 26594                                  	;sub	ax,[di+6]
 26595 00004324 2B4506                  	sub	ax,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector]
 26596 00004327 F7D8                    	neg	ax
 26597                                  
 26598                                  ;       AX = offset (in sectors) of buffer sector within Transfer memory
 26599                                  ;            block. (Note: the upper word of the sector # may be ignored
 26600                                  ;	     since no more than 64k bytes will ever be read. This 64k limit
 26601                                  ;            is imposed by the input parameters of the disk read operation.)
 26602                                  
 26603                                  	;lea	si,[di+20]
 26604 00004329 8D7518                  	lea	si,[di+BUFINSIZ]	;DS:SI -> buffer data.
 26605                                  	;mov	cx,[es:bp+2]
 26606 0000432C 268B4E02                	mov     cx,[es:bp+DPB.SECTOR_SIZE] ;CX = sector size (in bytes).
 26607 00004330 F7E1                    	mul     cx			;AX = offset (in bytes) of buf. sector
 26608                                  	;mov	di,[ss:TEMP_VAR]
 26609                                  	; 09/02/2024
 26610 00004332 36C43E[0C06]            	les	di,[ss:TEMP_VAR]
 26611 00004337 01C7                    	add	di,ax
 26612                                  	;mov	es,[ss:TEMP_VAR2]
 26613 00004339 D1E9                    	shr	cx,1
 26614                                  
 26615                                  ;	   CX = sector size (in WORDs) ; CF=1 if odd # of bytes.
 26616                                  ;       DS:SI-> Buffer sector data.
 26617                                  ;       ES:DI-> Destination within Transfer memory block.
 26618                                  
 26619                                  ; 09/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 26620                                  %if 0
 26621                                  	rep	movsw			;Copy buffer sector to Transfer memory
 26622                                  	;; 04/05/2019
 26623                                  	;;adc	cx,0                    ;CX=1 if odd # of bytes, else CX=0.
 26624                                  	;;rep	movsb                   ;Copy last byte.
 26625                                  	;jnc	short bufq03
 26626                                  	;movsb
 26627                                  	; 18/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 26628                                  	;adc	cx,0
 26629                                  	;rep	movsb
 26630                                  	; 22/09/2023
 26631                                  	jnc	short bufq03
 26632                                  	movsb
 26633                                  %else
 26634                                  	;;;
 26635                                  	; 09/02/2024 (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 26636 0000433B 36803E[6A00]00          	cmp	byte [ss:DDMOVE],0
 26637                                  	;jz	short bufq03+1 ; rep movsw (skip 32bit prefix)
 26638                                  	; 06/04/2024 
 26639 00004341 7403                    	jz	short bufq03
 26640 00004343 D1E9                    	shr	cx,1
 26641                                  ;bufq03:
 26642                                  	;rep	movsd
 26643                                  	; 06/04/2024
 26644 00004345 66                      	db	66h	; 32bit prefix
 26645                                  bufq03:
 26646 00004346 F3A5                    	rep	movsw
 26647                                  	;;;
 26648                                  %endif
 26649                                  
 26650                                  ;bufq03:	; 09/02/2024
 26651                                  	;RestoreReg <es,di,si,dx,cx>
 26652 00004348 07                      	pop	es
 26653 00004349 5F                      	pop	di
 26654 0000434A 5E                      	pop	si
 26655 0000434B 5A                      	pop	dx
 26656 0000434C 59                      	pop	cx
 26657                                  
 26658                                  ;       DS:DI -> current buffer.
 26659                                  bufq3:	
 26660 0000434D 89F8                    	mov     ax,di			;DS:AX -> Current buffer.
 26661                                          ;invoke SCANPLACE
 26662 0000434F E87425                  	call	SCANPLACE
 26663 00004352 363B06[7E11]            	cmp	ax,[ss:FIRST_BUFF_ADDR] ;Last buffer?
 26664 00004357 58                      	pop	ax
 26665                                  	;jne	short bufq		; -no, jump.
 26666                                  	;;jmp	short bufx		; -yes, exit.
 26667                                  	;; 12/06/2019
 26668                                  	;retn
 26669                                  	; 18/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compability)
 26670 00004358 7599                    	jne	short bufq
 26671                                  	;jmp	short bufx
 26672                                  	; 09/02/2024
 26673 0000435A C3                      	retn	; Exit
 26674                                  
 26675                                  ;EndProc DskRdBufScan

 27674                                  ;Break   <DskWrtBufPurge -- Disk Write Buffer Purge>
 27675                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27676                                  ;
 27677                                  ; Procedure Name : DskWrtBufPurge
 27678                                  ;
 27679                                  ; Inputs:
 27680                                  ;       CX = # of contiguous sectors to write. (These constitute a block of
 27681                                  ;	     sectors, also termed an "Extent".)
 27682                                  ;       [HIGH_SECTOR]:DX = physical sector # of first sector in extent.
 27683                                  ;       ES:BP -> Drive Parameter Block (DPB).
 27684                                  ;
 27685                                  ; Function:
 27686                                  ;       Purge the Buffer Queue and the Secondary Cache of any buffers which
 27687                                  ;	are in Extent; they are being over-written.
 27688                                  ;
 27689                                  ; Outputs:
 27690                                  ;       (Same as Input.)
 27691                                  ; Uses:
 27692                                  ;       All registers except DS,AX,SI,DI preserved.
 27693                                  ;       SS override for all global variables.
 27694                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27695                                  ;M039: Created
 27696                                  
 27697                                  ;procedure   DskWrtBufPurge,NEAR
 27698                                  ;
 27699                                  ;ASSUME  DS:NOTHING
 27700                                  
 27701                                  ; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 27702                                  ; DOSCODE:7C0Eh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 27703                                  
 27704                                  ; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 27705                                  ; DOSCODE:7BD4h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 27706                                  
 27707                                  ; 10/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 27708                                  ; DOSCODE:8714h (PCDOS 7.1, IBMDOS.COM)
 27709                                  
 27710                                  ; NOTE: Secondary (Buffer) Cache is not used in PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM
 27711                                  
 27712                                  ; (Win ME IO.SYS - BIOSCODE:BB93h)
 27713                                  ; (MSDOS 6.22 IO.SYS - DOSCODE:7C0Eh)
 27714                                  
 27715                                  DskWrtBufPurge:
 27716                                  	;SaveReg <bx,cx>
 27717 000046BA 53                      	push	bx
 27718 000046BB 51                      	push	cx
 27719                                  
 27720 000046BC 368B1E[0706]            	mov	bx,[ss:HIGH_SECTOR]	;BX:DX = Extent start (sector #).
 27721 000046C1 89DE                    	mov	si,bx
 27722 000046C3 01D1                    	add	cx,dx
 27723 000046C5 83D600                  	adc	si,0                    ;SI:CX = Extent end + 1.
 27724                                  
 27725                                  	; 21/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 27726                                  	;;mov	al,[es:bp+0]
 27727                                  	;mov	al,[es:bp+DPB.DRIVE]
 27728                                  	; 15/12/2022
 27729 000046C8 268A4600                	mov	al,[es:bp]
 27730                                  
 27731                                  ; 10/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 27732                                  ; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM
 27733                                  %if 0
 27734                                  
 27735                                  ;	BX:DX = Extent start.
 27736                                  ;	SI:CX = Extent end + 1.
 27737                                  ;	AL = Drive #
 27738                                  
 27739                                  	cmp	word [ss:SC_CACHE_COUNT],0 ;Secondary cache in-use?
 27740                                  	je	short nosc		; -no, jump.
 27741                                  
 27742                                  ;	If any of the sectors to be written are in the secondary cache (SC),
 27743                                  ;	invalidate the entire SC. (This is an optimization; we really only
 27744                                  ;	need to invalidate those sectors which intersect, but that's slower.)
 27745                                  
 27746                                  	cmp	al,[ss:CurSC_DRIVE]	;Same drive?
 27747                                  	jne	short nosc		; -no, jump.
 27748                                  
 27749                                  	push    ax
 27750                                  	mov     ax,[ss:CurSC_SECTOR]
 27751                                  	mov     di,[ss:CurSC_SECTOR+2]	;DI:AX = SC start.
 27752                                  
 27753                                  	;Cmp32	si,cx,di,ax		;Extent end < SC start?
 27754                                  	;jbe	short sc5		; -yes, jump.
 27755                                  
 27756                                  	cmp	si,di
 27757                                  	jne	short sc01
 27758                                  	cmp	cx,ax
 27759                                  sc01:
 27760                                  	jbe	short sc5
 27761                                  
 27762                                  	add	ax,[ss:SC_CACHE_COUNT]
 27763                                  	adc	di,0                    ;DI:AX = SC end + 1.
 27764                                  	
 27765                                  	;Cmp32	bx,dx,di,ax             ;Extent start > SC end?
 27766                                  	;jae	short sc5		; -yes, jump.
 27767                                  
 27768                                  	cmp	bx,di
 27769                                  	jne	short sc02
 27770                                  	cmp	dx,ax
 27771                                  sc02:
 27772                                  	jnb	short sc5
 27773                                  
 27774                                  	mov	word [ss:SC_STATUS],0	;Extent intersects SC: invalidate SC.
 27775                                  sc5:
 27776                                  	pop     ax
 27777                                  
 27778                                  %endif
 27779                                  
 27780                                  ;	Free any buffered sectors which are in Extent; they are being over-
 27781                                  ;	written.
 27782                                  
 27783                                  nosc:	
 27784 000046CC E8E521                  	call	GETCURHEAD		;DS:DI -> first buffer in queue.
 27785                                  
 27786                                  _bufq:	
 27787                                  	;cmpo	al,[di+4]
 27788 000046CF 3A4504                  	cmp     al,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_ID] ;Same drive?
 27789 000046D2 7527                    	jne	short bufq5		; -no, jump.
 27790                                  
 27791                                  ;       Cmp32   bx,dx,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector+2]>,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector]>
 27792                                  ;       ja	short bufq5		;Jump if Extent start > buffer sector.
 27793                                  
 27794                                  	;cmp	bx,[di+8]
 27795 000046D4 3B5D08                  	cmp	bx,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector+2]
 27796 000046D7 7503                    	jne	short bufq04
 27797                                  	;cmp	dx,[di+6]
 27798 000046D9 3B5506                  	cmp	dx,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector]
 27799                                  bufq04:
 27800 000046DC 771D                    	ja	short bufq5
 27801                                  
 27802                                  ;       Cmp32   si,cx,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector+2]>,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector]>
 27803                                  ;       jbe	short bufq5		;Jump if Extent end < buffer sector.
 27804                                  
 27805                                  	;cmp	si,[di+8]
 27806 000046DE 3B7508                  	cmp	si,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector+2]
 27807 000046E1 7503                    	jne	short bufq05
 27808                                  	;cmp	cx,[di+6]
 27809 000046E3 3B4D06                  	cmp	cx,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector]
 27810                                  bufq05:
 27811 000046E6 7613                    	jbe	short bufq5
 27812                                  
 27813                                  ;	Buffer's sector is in Extent, so free it; it is being over-written.
 27814                                  
 27815                                  	;test	byte [di+5],40h
 27816 000046E8 F6450540                	test	byte [di+BUFFINFO.buf_flags],buf_dirty ;Buffer dirty?
 27817 000046EC 7403                    	jz	short bufq4		; -no, jump.
 27818 000046EE E8DA24                  	call	DEC_DIRTY_COUNT		; -yes, decrement dirty count.
 27819                                  bufq4:
 27820                                  	;mov	word [di+4],20FFh
 27821 000046F1 C74504FF20              	mov     word [di+BUFFINFO.buf_ID],((buf_visit<<8)|0FFh)
 27822                                  
 27823 000046F6 E8CD21                  	call	SCANPLACE
 27824 000046F9 EB02                    	jmp     short bufq6
 27825                                  bufq5: 
 27826 000046FB 8B3D                    	mov     di,[di]
 27827                                  	;mov	di,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_next]
 27828                                  bufq6: 
 27829 000046FD 363B3E[7E11]            	cmp	di,[ss:FIRST_BUFF_ADDR]	;Scanned entire buffer queue?
 27830 00004702 75CB                    	jne	short _bufq		; --no, go do next buffer.
 27831                                  	
 27832                                  	;RestoreReg <cx,bx>
 27833 00004704 59                      	pop	cx
 27834 00004705 5B                      	pop	bx
 27835 00004706 C3                      	retn

 27839                                  ;Break   <DIV32 -- PERFORM 32 BIT DIVIDE>
 27840                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27841                                  ;
 27842                                  ; Procedure Name : DIV32
 27843                                  ;
 27844                                  ; Inputs:
 27845                                  ;       DX:AX = 32 bit dividend   BX= divisor
 27846                                  ; Function:
 27847                                  ;       Perform 32 bit division:  DX:AX/BX = CX:AX + DX (rem.)
 27848                                  ; Outputs:
 27849                                  ;       CX:AX = quotient , DX= remainder
 27850                                  ; Uses:
 27851                                  ;       All registers except AX,CX,DX preserved.
 27852                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27853                                  ;M039: DIV32 optimized for divisor of 512 (common sector size).
 27854                                  
 27855                                  ; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 27856                                  ; DOSCODE:7C94h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 27857                                  
 27858                                  ; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 27859                                  ; DOSCODE:7C5Ah (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 27860                                  
 27861                                  DIV32:
 27862 00004707 81FB0002                	cmp	bx,512
 27863 0000470B 7515                    	jne	short div5
 27864                                  
 27865 0000470D 89D1                    	mov	cx,dx
 27866 0000470F 89C2                    	mov	dx,ax           ; CX:AX = Dividend
 27867 00004711 81E2FF01                	and	dx,(512-1)      ; DX = Remainder
 27868 00004715 88E0                    	mov	al,ah
 27869 00004717 88CC                    	mov	ah,cl
 27870 00004719 88E9                    	mov	cl,ch
 27871 0000471B 30ED                    	xor	ch,ch
 27872 0000471D D1E9                    	shr	cx,1
 27873 0000471F D1D8                    	rcr	ax,1
 27874 00004721 C3                      	retn
 27875                                  div5:
 27876 00004722 89C1                    	mov	cx,ax
 27877 00004724 89D0                    	mov	ax,dx
 27878 00004726 31D2                    	xor	dx,dx
 27879 00004728 F7F3                    	div	bx              ; 0:AX/BX
 27880 0000472A 91                      	xchg	cx,ax
 27881 0000472B F7F3                    	div	bx              ; DX:AX/BX
 27882 0000472D C3                      	retn
 27883                                  
 27884                                  ;Break   <SHR32 -- PERFORM 32 BIT SHIFT RIGHT>
 27885                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27886                                  ;
 27887                                  ; Procedure Name : SHR32
 27888                                  ;
 27889                                  ; Inputs:
 27890                                  ;	DX:AX = 32 bit sector number
 27891                                  ; Function:
 27892                                  ;       Perform 32 bit shift right
 27893                                  ; Outputs:
 27894                                  ;	AX = cluster number
 27895                                  ;	ZF = 1 if no error
 27896                                  ;	   = 0 if error (cluster number > 64k)
 27897                                  ; Uses:
 27898                                  ;       DX,CX
 27899                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27900                                  ; M017	- SHR32 rewritten for better performance
 27901                                  ; M039	- Additional optimization
 27902                                  
 27903                                  ; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 27904                                  ; DOSCODE:7CBBh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 27905                                  ; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 27906                                  ; DOSCODE:7C81h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS) 
 27907                                  
 27908                                  SHR32:
 27909                                  	;mov	cl,[es:bp+5]
 27910 0000472E 268A4E05                	mov	cl,[ES:BP+DPB.CLUSTER_SHIFT]
 27911 00004732 30ED                    	xor	ch,ch	    ;ZF=1
 27912 00004734 E306                    	jcxz	norota
 27913                                  rotashft2:
 27914 00004736 D1EA                    	shr	dx,1	    ;ZF reflects state of DX.
 27915 00004738 D1D8                    	rcr	ax,1	    ;ZF not affected.
 27916 0000473A E2FA                    	loop	rotashft2
 27917                                  norota:
 27918 0000473C C3                      	retn

 28165                                  ; Procedure Name : MetaCompare
 28166                                  ;
 28167                                  ; Inputs:
 28168                                  ;	DS:SI -> 11 character FCB style name NO '?'
 28169                                  ;	    Typically this is a directory entry. It MUST be in upper case

 28171                                  ;	    Typically this is a FCB or SFT. It MUST be in upper case
 28172                                  ; Function:
 28173                                  ;	Compare FCB style names allowing for ? match to any char
 28174                                  ; Outputs:

 28903                                  
 28904                                  ;	TITLE	DIR2 - Directory and path cracking
 28905                                  ;	NAME	Dir2
 28906                                  
 28907                                  ;Break	<GETPATH -- PARSE A WFP>
 28908                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 28909                                  ;
 28910                                  ; Procedure Name : GETPATH
 28911                                  ;
 28912                                  ; Inputs:
 28913                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:\" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 28914                                  ;		terminated; d:/ (note forward slash) indicates a real device).
 28915                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 28916                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 28917                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 28918                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 28919                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 28920                                  ;	[NoSetDir] set
 28921                                  ;	[THISDPB] set to DPB if disk otherwise garbage.
 28922                                  ; Function:
 28923                                  ;	Crack the path
 28924                                  ; Outputs:
 28925                                  ;	Sets EXTERR_LOCUS = errLOC_Disk if disk file
 28926                                  ;	Sets EXTERR_LOCUS = errLOC_Unk if char device
 28927                                  ;	ID1 field of [THISCDS] updated appropriately
 28928                                  ;	[ATTRIB] = [SATTRIB]
 28929                                  ;	ES:BP Points to DPB
 28930                                  ;	Carry set if bad path
 28931                                  ;	   SI Points to path element causing failure
 28932                                  ;	   Zero set
 28933                                  ;	      [DIRSTART],[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM], and [CLUSFAC] are set up to
 28934                                  ;	      start a search on the last directory
 28935                                  ;	      CL is zero if there is a bad name in the path
 28936                                  ;	      CL is non-zero if the name was simply not found
 28937                                  ;		 [ENTFREE] may have free spot in directory
 28938                                  ;		 [NAME1] is the name.
 28939                                  ;		 CL = 81H if '*'s or '?' in NAME1, 80H otherwise
 28940                                  ;	   Zero reset
 28941                                  ;	      File in middle of path or bad name in path or attribute mismatch
 28942                                  ;		or path too long or malformed path
 28943                                  ;	ELSE
 28944                                  ;	   [CurBuf] = -1 if root directory
 28945                                  ;	   [CURBUF] contains directory record with match
 28946                                  ;	   [CURBUF+2]:BX Points into [CURBUF] to start of entry
 28947                                  ;	   [CURBUF+2]:SI Points into [CURBUF] to dir_first field for entry
 28948                                  ;	   AH = device ID
 28949                                  ;	      bit 7 of AH set if device SI and BX
 28950                                  ;	      will point DOSGROUP relative The firclus
 28951                                  ;	      field of the device entry contains the device pointer
 28952                                  ;	   [NAME1] Has name looked for
 28953                                  ;	   If last element is a directory zero is set and:
 28954                                  ;	      [DIRSTART],[SECCLUSPOS],[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM], and [CLUSFAC]
 28955                                  ;	      are set up to start a search on it.
 28956                                  ;	      unless [NoSetDir] is non zero in which case the return is
 28957                                  ;	      like that for a file (except for zero flag)
 28958                                  ;	   If last element is a file zero is reset
 28959                                  ;	      [DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM],[CLUSFAC],[NXTCLUSNUM],[SECCLUSPOS],
 28960                                  ;	      [LASTENT], [ENTLAST] are set to continue search of last
 28961                                  ;	      directory for furthur matches on NAME1 via the NEXTENT
 28962                                  ;	      entry point in FindEntry (or GETENT entry in GETENTRY in
 28963                                  ;	      which case [NXTCLUSNUM] and [SECCLUSPOS] need not be valid)
 28964                                  ; DS preserved, Others destroyed
 28965                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 28966                                  
 28967                                  ;hkn; called from delete.asm, finfo.asm, mknode.asm and rename.asm.
 28968                                  ;hkn; DS already set up at this point.
 28969                                  
 28970                                  	; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 28971                                  
 28972                                  	; 15/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 28973                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:8B99h
 28974

 28977 00004B0F C706[7E05]00E5          	MOV	WORD [CREATING],DIRFREE*256+0 ; Not Creating, not DEL *.*
 28978

 28980

 28992

 29010                                  Build_devJ:
 29011 00004B31 A0[6D05]                	MOV	AL,[SATTRIB]
 29012 00004B34 A2[6B05]                	MOV	[ATTRIB],AL
 29013                                  	; 15/02/2024
 29014                                  	;;mov	byte [EXTERR_LOCUS],1
 29015                                  	;MOV	byte [EXTERR_LOCUS],errLOC_Unk ; In the particular case of
 29016                                  					; "finding" a char device
 29017                                  					; set LOCUS to Unknown. This makes
 29018                                  					; certain idiotic problems reported
 29019                                  					; by a certain 3 letter OEM go away.
 29020                                  	; 15/02/2024 (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 29021 00004B37 E8A3C7                  	call	set_exerr_locus_unk
 29022                                  
 29023                                  ; Take name in name1 and pack it back into where wfp_start points. This
 29024                                  ; guarantees wfp_start pointing to a canonical representation of a device.
 29025                                  ; We are allowed to do this as GetPath is *ALWAYS* called before entering a
 29026                                  ; wfp into the share set.

 29249                                  ;Break	<ROOTPATH, FINDPATH -- PARSE A PATH>
 29250                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 29251                                  ;
 29252                                  ; Procedure Name : ROOTPATH,FINDPATH
 29253                                  ;
 29254                                  ; Inputs:
 29255                                  ;	Same as FINDPATH but,
 29256                                  ;	SI Points to asciz string of path which is assumed to start at
 29257                                  ;		the root (no leading '/').
 29258                                  ; Function:
 29259                                  ;	Search from root for path
 29260                                  ; Outputs:
 29261                                  ;	Same as FINDPATH but:
 29262                                  ;	If root directory specified, [CURBUF] and [NAME1] are NOT set, and
 29263                                  ;	[NoSetDir] is ignored.
 29264                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 29265                                  
 29266                                  	; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 29267                                  	; DOSCODE:7F47h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 29268                                  
 29269                                  	; 15/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 29270                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:8C9Dh
 29271                                  
 29272                                  	; (MSDOS 6.22 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:7F82h)
 29273                                  	; (Windows ME IO.SYS - BIOSCODE:829Eh)
 29274                                  
 29275                                  ROOTPATH:
 29276 00004C0B E879FD                  	call	SETROOTSRCH
 29277                                  	; 24/09/2023
 29278 00004C0E 30E4                    	xor	ah,ah
 29279                                  	;CMP	BYTE [SI],0
 29280 00004C10 3824                    	cmp	[si],ah ; 0
 29281 00004C12 7507                    	JNZ	short FINDPATH
 29282                                  
 29283                                  	;;;
 29284                                  	;; 15/02/2024
 29285                                  	; Windows ME IO.SYS - BIOSCODE:82A6h
 29286                                  	;mov	word [CURBUF],0FFFFh
 29287                                  	;;;
 29288                                  
 29289                                  ; Root dir specified
 29290 00004C14 A0[6D05]                	MOV	AL,[SATTRIB]
 29291 00004C17 A2[6B05]                	MOV	[ATTRIB],AL
 29292                                  	; 24/09/2023
 29293                                  	;XOR	AH,AH			; Sets "device ID" byte, sets zero
 29294                                  					; (dir), clears carry.
 29295 00004C1A C3                      	retn
 29296                                  
 29297                                  ; Inputs:
 29298                                  ;	[ATTRIB] Set to get through directories
 29299                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Set to find last element
 29300                                  ;	ES:BP Points to DPB
 29301                                  ;	SI Points to asciz string of path (no leading '/').
 29302                                  ;	[SECCLUSPOS] = 0
 29303                                  ;	[DIRSEC] = Phys sec # of first sector of directory
 29304                                  ;	[CLUSNUM] = Cluster # of next cluster
 29305                                  ;	[CLUSFAC] = Sectors per cluster
 29306                                  ;	[NoSetDir] set
 29307                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 29308                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 29309                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 29310                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 29311                                  ;	[CREATING] and [DELALL] set
 29312                                  ; Function:
 29313                                  ;	Parse path name
 29314                                  ; Outputs:
 29315                                  ;	ID1 field of [THISCDS] updated appropriately
 29316                                  ;	[ATTRIB] = [SATTRIB]
 29317                                  ;	ES:BP Points to DPB
 29318                                  ;	[THISDPB] = ES:BP
 29319                                  ;	Carry set if bad path
 29320                                  ;	   SI Points to path element causing failure
 29321                                  ;	   Zero set
 29322                                  ;	      [DIRSTART],[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM], and [CLUSFAC] are set up to
 29323                                  ;	      start a search on the last directory
 29324                                  ;	      CL is zero if there is a bad name in the path
 29325                                  ;	      CL is non-zero if the name was simply not found
 29326                                  ;		 [ENTFREE] may have free spot in directory
 29327                                  ;		 [NAME1] is the name.
 29328                                  ;		 CL = 81H if '*'s or '?' in NAME1, 80H otherwise
 29329                                  ;	   Zero reset
 29330                                  ;	      File in middle of path or bad name in path
 29331                                  ;		or path too long or malformed path
 29332                                  ;	ELSE
 29333                                  ;	   [CURBUF] contains directory record with match
 29334                                  ;	   [CURBUF+2]:BX Points into [CURBUF] to start of entry
 29335                                  ;	   [CURBUF+2]:SI Points to fcb_FIRCLUS field for entry
 29336                                  ;	   [NAME1] Has name looked for
 29337                                  ;	   AH = device ID
 29338                                  ;	      bit 7 of AH set if device SI and BX
 29339                                  ;	      will point DOSGROUP relative The firclus
 29340                                  ;	      field of the device entry contains the device pointer
 29341                                  ;	   If last element is a directory zero is set and:
 29342                                  ;	      [DIRSTART],[SECCLUSPOS],[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM], and [CLUSFAC]
 29343                                  ;	      are set up to start a search on it,
 29344                                  ;	      unless [NoSetDir] is non zero in which case the return is
 29345                                  ;	      like that for a file (except for zero flag)
 29346                                  ;	   If last element is a file zero is reset
 29347                                  ;	      [DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM],[CLUSFAC],[NXTCLUSNUM],[SECCLUSPOS],
 29348                                  ;	      [LASTENT], [ENTLAST] are set to continue search of last
 29349                                  ;	      directory for furthur matches on NAME1 via the NEXTENT
 29350                                  ;	      entry point in FindEntry (or GETENT entry in GETENTRY in
 29351                                  ;	      which case [NXTCLUSNUM] and [SECCLUSPOS] need not be valid)
 29352                                  ; Destroys all other registers
 29353                                  
 29354                                  	; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 29355                                  	; DOSCODE:7F58h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 29356                                  
 29357                                  	; 15/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 29358                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:8CAEh
 29359                                  
 29360                                      	;entry	FINDPATH
 29361                                  FINDPATH:
 29362 00004C1B 06                      	PUSH	ES			; Save ES:BP
 29363 00004C1C 56                      	PUSH	SI
 29364 00004C1D 89F7                    	MOV	DI,SI
 29365 00004C1F 8B0E[C205]              	MOV	CX,[DIRSTART]		; Get start clus of dir being searched
 29366 00004C23 833E[B605]FF            	CMP	word [CURR_DIR_END],-1
 29367 00004C28 7415                    	JZ	short NOIDS		; No current dir part
 29368 00004C2A 3B3E[B605]              	CMP	DI,[CURR_DIR_END]
 29369 00004C2E 750F                    	JNZ	short NOIDS		; Not to current dir end yet
 29370 00004C30 C43E[A205]              	LES	DI,[THISCDS]
 29371                                  	;;;
 29372                                  	; 15/02/2024 (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 29373 00004C34 A1[DC0A]                	mov	ax,[DIRSTART_HW]
 29374                                  	;mov	[es:di+4Bh],ax
 29375 00004C37 2689454B                	mov	[es:di+curdir.ID+2],ax
 29376                                  	;;;
 29377                                  	;mov	[es:di+73],cx
 29378 00004C3B 26894D49                	MOV	[ES:DI+curdir.ID],CX	; Set current directory cluster
 29379                                  NOIDS:
 29380                                  
 29381                                  ; Parse the name off of DS:SI into NAME1. AL = 1 if there was a meta
 29382                                  ; character in the string. CX,DI may be destroyed.
 29383                                  ;
 29384                                  ;	invoke	NAMETRANS
 29385                                  ;	MOV	CL,AL
 29386                                  ;
 29387                                  ; The above is the slow method. The name has *already* been munged by
 29388                                  ; TransPath so no special casing needs to be done. All we do is try to copy
 29389                                  ; the name until ., \ or 0 is hit.
 29390                                  
 29391                                  	;MOV	AX,SS
 29392                                  	;MOV	ES,AX
 29393                                  	; 15/02/2024 (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 29394 00004C3F 16                      	push	ss
 29395 00004C40 07                      	pop	es
 29396                                  
 29397                                  ;hkn; Name1 is in DOSDATA
 29398 00004C41 BF[4B05]                	MOV	DI,NAME1
 29399 00004C44 B82020                  	MOV	AX,'  ' ; 2020h
 29400 00004C47 AA                      	STOSB
 29401 00004C48 AB                      	STOSW
 29402 00004C49 AB                      	STOSW
 29403 00004C4A AB                      	STOSW
 29404 00004C4B AB                      	STOSW
 29405 00004C4C AB                      	STOSW
 29406                                  
 29407                                  ;hkn; Name1 is in DOSDATA
 29408 00004C4D BF[4B05]                	MOV	DI,NAME1
 29409 00004C50 30E4                    	XOR	AH,AH			; bits for CL
 29410                                  GetNam:
 29411                                  	; 19/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 29412                                  	;INC	CL ; ?*! ; MSDOS 6.0	;AN000; KK increment volid count
 29413                                  
 29414                                  	; 21/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 29415                                  	; 16/12/2022
 29416                                  	;inc	cl ; not required !
 29417                                  	
 29418 00004C52 AC                      	LODSB
 29419 00004C53 3C2E                    	CMP	AL,'.'	; 2Eh
 29420 00004C55 7412                    	JZ	short _SetExt
 29421 00004C57 08C0                    	OR	AL,AL
 29422 00004C59 7424                    	JZ	short _GetDone
 29423 00004C5B 3C5C                    	CMP	AL,'\'	; 5Ch
 29424 00004C5D 7420                    	JZ	short _GetDone
 29425 00004C5F 3C3F                    	CMP	AL,'?'	; 3Fh
 29426 00004C61 7503                    	JNZ	short StoNam
 29427 00004C63 80CC01                  	OR	AH,1
 29428                                  StoNam: 
 29429 00004C66 AA                      	STOSB
 29430 00004C67 EBE9                    	JMP	short GetNam

 29432 00004C69 BF[5305]                	MOV	DI,NAME1+8

 29448 00004C82 80C980                  	OR	CL,80H

 29450 00004C86 07                      	POP	ES			; Restore ES:BP
 29451 00004C87 39FE                    	CMP	SI,DI

 29454                                  check_device:

 29456                                  	;MOV	AL,[SI]
 29457                                  	; 15/02/2024

 29462                                  
 29463                                  ; for last element of the path switch to the correct search attributes
 29464

 29466 00004C97 883E[6B05]              	MOV	[ATTRIB],BH

 29490                                  
 29491                                  FindFile:
 29492                                  ;;;; 7/28/86
 29493 00004CAC 803E[4B05]E5            	CMP	BYTE [NAME1],0E5H	; if 1st char = E5
 29494 00004CB1 7505                    	JNZ	short NOE5		; no

 29956                                  ;Break	<ValidateCDS - given a CDS, validate the media and the current directory>
 29957                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 29958                                  ;
 29959                                  ;   ValidateCDS - Get current CDS. Splice it. Call FatReadCDS to check
 29960                                  ;   media. If media has been changed, do DOS_Chdir to validate path.
 29961                                  ;   If invalid, reset original CDS to root.
 29962                                  ;
 29963                                  ;   Inputs:	ThisCDS points to CDS of interest
 29964                                  ;		SS:DI points to temp buffer
 29965                                  ;   Outputs:	The current directory string is validated on the appropriate
 29966                                  ;		    drive
 29967                                  ;		ThisDPB changed
 29968                                  ;		ES:DI point to CDS
 29969                                  ;		Carry set if error (currently user FAILed to I 24)

 30157                                  ;Break	<CheckThisDevice - Check for being a device>
 30158                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30159                                  ;
 30160                                  ;   CheckThisDevice - Examine the area at DS:SI to see if there is a valid
 30161                                  ;   device specified. We will return carry if there is a device present. 
 30162                                  ;   The forms of devices we will recognize are:
 30163                                  ;
 30164                                  ;	[path]device
 30165                                  ;
 30166                                  ;   Note that the drive letter has *already* been removed. All other forms
 30167                                  ;   are not considered to be devices. If such a device is found we change
 30168                                  ;   the source pointer to point to the device component.
 30169                                  ;
 30170                                  ;   Inputs:	ES is DOSDATA
 30171                                  ;		DS:SI contains name
 30172                                  ;   Outputs:	ES is DOSDATA
 30173                                  ;		DS:SI point to name or device
 30174                                  ;		Carry flag set if device was found
 30175                                  ;		Carry flag reset otherwise
 30176                                  ;   Registers Modified: all except ES:DI, DS
 30177                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30178

 30180 00004F29 57                      	push	di
 30181 00004F2A 56                      	push	si

 30185                                  
 30186 00004F2D 8A04                    	MOV	AL,[SI]

 30190                                  
 30191                                  ; We have the leading path separator. Look for DEV part.
 30192

 30198 00004F3E AC                      	LODSB
 30199 00004F3F 0C20                    	OR	AL,20h
 30200 00004F41 3C76                    	CMP	AL,"v"                  ; Not "v", assume not device
 30201 00004F43 7526                    	JNZ	short NotDevice
 30202 00004F45 AC                      	LODSB
 30203 00004F46 E89D0E                  	call	PATHCHRCMP		; do we have the last path separator?
 30204 00004F49 7520                    	JNZ	short NotDevice		; no. go for it.
 30205

 31341                                  ; DOSCODE:86A8h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 31342                                  ; 22/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 31343                                  ; DOSCODE:866Dh (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)

 31345                                  ;Break	<RW_SC -- Read Write Secondary Cache>
 31346                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31347                                  ;
 31348                                  ; Procedure Name : RW_SC
 31349                                  ;
 31350                                  ; Inputs:
 31351                                  ;	 [SC_CACHE_COUNT]= secondary cache count
 31352                                  ;	 [SC_STATUS]= SC validity status
 31353                                  ;	 [SEQ_SECTOR]= last sector read
 31354                                  ; Function:
 31355                                  ;	Read from or write through secondary cache
 31356                                  ; Output:
 31357                                  ;	ES:BX Points to DEVCALL
 31358                                  ;	carry clear, I/O is not done
 31359                                  ;		     [SC_FLAG]=1 if continuos sectors will be read
 31360                                  ;	carry set, I/O is done
 31361                                  ;
 31362                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31363                                  
 31364                                  RW_SC:
 31365                                  	; SS override for all variables used.
 31366                                  	
 31367                                  	CMP	word [ss:SC_CACHE_COUNT],0  ;AN000;LB. secondary cache exists?
 31368                                  	;JZ	short scexit4		    ;AN000;LB. no, do nothing
 31369                                  	; 04/02/2026
 31370                                  	jz	short scexit5
 31371                                  	CMP	word [ss:CALLSCNT],1	    ;AN000;LB. sector count = 1 (buffer I/O)
 31372                                  	JNZ	short scexit4 		    ;AN000;LB. no, do nothing
 31373                                  	PUSH	CX			    ;AN000;LB.
 31374                                  	PUSH	DX			    ;AN000;LB. yes
 31375                                  	PUSH	DS			    ;AN000;LB. save registers
 31376                                  	PUSH	SI			    ;AN000;LB.
 31377                                  	PUSH	ES			    ;AN000;LB.
 31378                                  	PUSH	DI			    ;AN000;LB.
 31379                                  
 31380                                  	MOV	DX,[ss:CALLSSEC]	    ;AN000;LB. starting sector
 31381                                  	CMP	BYTE [ss:DEVCALL_REQFUNC],DEVRD ;AN000;LB. read ?
 31382                                  	JZ	short doread		    ;AN000;LB. yes
 31383                                  	CALL	INVALIDATE_SC		    ;AN000;LB. invalidate SC
 31384                                  	;JMP	scexit2 		    ;AN000;LB. back to normal
 31385                                  	; 04/02/2026
 31386                                  	clc
 31387                                  	jmp	scexit
 31388                                  scexit4:				    ;AN000;
 31389                                  	CLC				    ;AN000;LB. I/O not done yet
 31390                                  scexit5: ; 04/02/2026
 31391                                  	retn				    ;AN000;LB.
 31392                                  doread: 				    ;AN000;
 31393                                  	CALL	SC2BUF			    ;AN000;LB. check if in SC
 31394                                  	JC	short readSC		    ;AN000;LB.
 31395                                  	MOV	word [ss:DEVCALL_REQSTAT],STDON ;AN000;LB. fake done and ok
 31396                                  	STC				    ;AN000;LB. set carry
 31397                                  	JMP	short saveseq 		    ;AN000;LB. save seq. sector #
 31398                                  readSC: 				    ;AN000;
 31399                                  	MOV	AX,[ss:HIGH_SECTOR]   	    ;AN000;LB. subtract sector num from
 31400                                  	MOV	CX,[ss:CALLSSEC]	    ;AN000;LB. saved sequential sector
 31401                                  	SUB	CX,[ss:SEQ_SECTOR]    	    ;AN000;LB. number
 31402                                  	SBB	AX,[ss:SEQ_SECTOR+2]  	    ;AN000;LB.
 31403                                  	; 24/09/2023
 31404                                  	;CMP	AX,0			    ;AN000;LB. greater than 64K
 31405                                  	JNZ	short saveseq2		    ;AN000;LB. yes,save seq. sector #
 31406                                  chklow: 						
 31407                                  	CMP	CX,1			    ;AN000;LB. <= 1
 31408                                  	;JA	short saveseq2		    ;AN000;LB. no, not sequential
 31409                                  	; 04/02/2026
 31410                                  	ja	short saveseq
 31411                                  	MOV	word [ss:SC_STATUS],-1	    ;AN000;LB. presume all SC valid
 31412                                  	MOV	AX,[ss:SC_CACHE_COUNT]	    ;AN000;LB. yes, sequential
 31413                                  	MOV	[ss:CALLSCNT],AX	    ;AN000;LB. read continuous sectors
 31414                                  readsr:
 31415                                  	MOV	AX,[ss:CALLXAD+2]	    ;AN000;LB. save buffer addr
 31416                                  	MOV	[ss:TEMP_VAR2],AX	    ;AN000;LB. in temp vars
 31417                                  	MOV	AX,[ss:CALLXAD]	    	    ;AN000;LB.
 31418                                  	MOV	[ss:TEMP_VAR],AX	    ;AN000;LB.
 31419                                  
 31420                                  	MOV	AX,[ss:SC_CACHE_PTR]	    ;AN000;LB. use SC cache addr as
 31421                                  	MOV	[ss:CALLXAD],AX		    ;AN000;LB. transfer addr
 31422                                  	MOV	AX,[ss:SC_CACHE_PTR+2]	    ;AN000;LB.
 31423                                  	MOV	[ss:CALLXAD+2],AX	    ;AN000;LB.
 31424                                  	MOV	byte [ss:SC_FLAG],1	    ;AN000;LB. flag it for later;
 31425                                  	MOV	AL,[ss:SC_DRIVE]	    ;AN000;LB. current drive
 31426                                  	MOV	[ss:CurSC_DRIVE],AL	    ;AN000;LB. set current drive
 31427                                  	MOV	AX,[ss:CALLSSEC]	    ;AN000;LB. current sector
 31428                                  	MOV	[ss:CurSC_SECTOR],AX	    ;AN000;LB. set current sector
 31429                                  	MOV	AX,[ss:HIGH_SECTOR]	    ;AN000;LB.
 31430                                  	MOV	[ss:CurSC_SECTOR+2],AX	    ;AN000;LB.
 31431                                  saveseq2:				    ;AN000;
 31432                                  	CLC				    ;AN000;LB. clear carry
 31433                                  saveseq:				    ;AN000;
 31434                                  	MOV	AX,[ss:HIGH_SECTOR]	    ;AN000;LB. save current sector #
 31435                                  	MOV	[ss:SEQ_SECTOR+2],AX	    ;AN000;LB. for access mode ref.
 31436                                  	MOV	AX,[ss:CALLSSEC]	    ;AN000;LB.
 31437                                  	MOV	[ss:SEQ_SECTOR],AX 	    ;AN000;LB.
 31438                                  	; 04/02/2026
 31439                                  	;JMP	short scexit 		    ;AN000;LB.
 31440                                  ;scexit2:				    ;AN000;LB.
 31441                                  	;CLC				    ;AN000;LB.	clear carry
 31442                                  scexit: 				    ;AN000;
 31443                                  	POP	DI			    ;AN000;LB.
 31444                                  	POP	ES			    ;AN000;LB. restore registers
 31445                                  	POP	SI			    ;AN000;LB.
 31446                                  	POP	DS			    ;AN000;LB.
 31447                                  	POP	DX			    ;AN000;LB.
 31448                                  	POP	CX			    ;AN000;LB.
 31449                                  	retn				    ;AN000;LB.
 31450                                  
 31451                                  ;Break	<IN_SC -- check if in secondary cache>
 31452                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31453                                  ;
 31454                                  ; Procedure Name : IN_SC
 31455                                  ;
 31456                                  ; Inputs:  [SC_DRIVE]= requesting drive
 31457                                  ;	   [CURSC_DRIVE]= current SC drive
 31458                                  ;	   [CURSC_SECTOR]= starting scetor # of SC
 31459                                  ;	   [SC_CACHE_COUNT]= SC count
 31460                                  ;	   [HIGH_SECTOR]:DX= sector number
 31461                                  ; Function:
 31462                                  ;	Check if the sector is in secondary cache
 31463                                  ; Output:
 31464                                  ;	carry clear, in SC
 31465                                  ;	   CX= the index in the secondary cache
 31466                                  ;	carry set, not in SC
 31467                                  ;
 31468                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31469                                  
 31470                                  	; 22/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 31471                                  IN_SC:
 31472                                  	; SS override for all variables used
 31473                                  	MOV	AL,[ss:SC_DRIVE]	    ;AN000;;LB. current drive
 31474                                  	CMP	AL,[ss:CurSC_DRIVE]	    ;AN000;;LB. same as SC drive
 31475                                  	JNZ	short outrange2		    ;AN000;;LB. no
 31476                                  	MOV	AX,[ss:HIGH_SECTOR]	    ;AN000;;LB. subtract sector num from
 31477                                  	MOV	CX,DX			    ;AN000;;LB. secondary starting sector
 31478                                  	SUB	CX,[ss:CurSC_SECTOR]        ;AN000;;LB. number
 31479                                  	SBB	AX,[ss:CurSC_SECTOR+2]      ;AN000;;LB.
 31480                                  	; 24/09/2023
 31481                                  	;CMP	AX,0			    ;AN000;;LB. greater than 64K
 31482                                  	JNZ	short outrange2		    ;AN000;;LB. yes
 31483                                  	CMP	CX,[ss:SC_CACHE_COUNT]	    ;AN000;;LB. greater than SC count
 31484                                  	JAE	short outrange2		    ;AN000;;LB. yes
 31485                                  	CLC				    ;AN000;;LB. clear carry
 31486                                  	;JMP	short inexit		    ;AN000;;LB. in SC
 31487                                  	; 16/12/2022
 31488                                  	retn	; 30/04/2019
 31489                                  	; 22/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 31490                                  	;jmp	short inexit
 31491                                  
 31492                                  outrange2:				    ;AN000;;LB. set carry
 31493                                  	STC				    ;AN000;;LB.
 31494                                  inexit: 				    ;AN000;;LB.
 31495                                  	retn				    ;AN000;;LB.

 31497                                  ;Break	<INVALIDATE_SC - invalide secondary cache>
 31498                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31499                                  ;
 31500                                  ; Procedure Name : Invalidate_Sc
 31501                                  ;
 31502                                  ; Inputs:  [SC_DRIVE]= requesting drive
 31503                                  ;	   [CURSC_DRIVE]= current SC drive
 31504                                  ;	   [CURSC_SECTOR]= starting scetor # of SC
 31505                                  ;	   [SC_CACHE_COUNT]= SC count
 31506                                  ;	   [SC_STATUS]= SC status word
 31507                                  ;	   [HIGH_SECTOR]:DX= sector number
 31508                                  ;
 31509                                  ; Function:
 31510                                  ;	invalidate secondary cache if in there
 31511                                  ; Output:
 31512                                  ;	[SC_STATUS] is updated
 31513                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31514                                  
 31515                                  INVALIDATE_SC:
 31516                                  	; SS override for all variables used
 31517                                  
 31518                                  	CALL	IN_SC			    ;AN000;;LB. in secondary cache
 31519                                  	JC	short outrange		    ;AN000;;LB. no
 31520                                  	MOV	AX,1			    ;AN000;;LB. invalidate the sector
 31521                                  	SHL	AX,CL			    ;AN000;;LB. in the secondary cache
 31522                                  	NOT	AX			    ;AN000;;LB.
 31523                                  	AND	[ss:SC_STATUS],AX	    ;AN000;;LB. save the status
 31524                                  outrange:				    ;AN000;;LB.
 31525                                  	retn				    ;AN000;;LB.
 31526                                  
 31527                                  ; DOSCODE:87A5h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 31528                                  ; 22/11/2022
 31529                                  ; DOSCODE:876Ah (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)

 31531                                  ;Break	<VIRREAD- virtually read data into buffer>
 31532                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31533                                  ;
 31534                                  ; Procedure Name : SC_FLAG
 31535                                  ;
 31536                                  ; Inputs:  SC_FLAG = 0, no sectors were read into SC
 31537                                  ;		     1, continuous sectors were read into SC
 31538                                  ; Function:
 31539                                  ;	   Move data from SC to buffer
 31540                                  ; Output:
 31541                                  ;	 carry clear, data is moved to buffer
 31542                                  ;	 carry set, bad sector or exceeds maximum sector
 31543                                  ;	   SC_FLAG =0
 31544                                  ;	   CALLSCNT=1
 31545                                  ;	   SC_STATUS= -1 if succeeded
 31546                                  ;
 31547                                  ;		       0 if failed
 31548                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31549                                  
 31550                                  VIRREAD:
 31551                                  	; SS override for all variables used
 31552                                  
 31553                                  	CMP	byte [ss:SC_FLAG],0	    ;AN000;;LB. from SC fill
 31554                                  	;JZ	short sc2end		    ;AN000;;LB. no
 31555                                  	; 04/02/2026
 31556                                  	jz	short sc2end2
 31557                                  	MOV	AX,[ss:TEMP_VAR2]	    ;AN000;;LB. restore buffer addr
 31558                                  	MOV	[ss:CALLXAD+2],AX	    ;AN000;;LB.
 31559                                  	MOV	AX,[ss:TEMP_VAR]	    ;AN000;;LB.
 31560                                  	MOV	[ss:CALLXAD],AX		    ;AN000;;LB.
 31561                                  	MOV	byte [ss:SC_FLAG],0	    ;AN000;;LB. reset sc_flag
 31562                                  	MOV	word [ss:CALLSCNT],1	    ;AN000;;LB. one sector transferred
 31563                                  
 31564                                  	;TEST	word [SS:DEVCALL_REQSTAT],STERR ;AN000;;LB. error?
 31565                                  	test	byte [ss:DEVCALL_REQSTAT+1],(STERR>>8) ; 80h
 31566                                  	JNZ	short scerror 		    ;AN000;;LB. yes
 31567                                  	PUSH	DS			    ;AN000;;LB.
 31568                                  	PUSH	SI			    ;AN000;;LB.
 31569                                  	PUSH	ES			    ;AN000;;LB.
 31570                                  	PUSH	DI			    ;AN000;;LB.
 31571                                  	PUSH	DX			    ;AN000;;LB.
 31572                                  	PUSH	CX			    ;AN000;;LB.
 31573                                  	XOR	CX,CX			    ;AN000;;LB. we want first sector in SC
 31574                                  	CALL	SC2BUF2 		    ;AN000;;LB. move data from SC to buf
 31575                                  	POP	CX
 31576                                  	POP	DX			    ;AN000;;LB.
 31577                                  	POP	DI			    ;AN000;;LB.
 31578                                  	POP	ES			    ;AN000;;LB.
 31579                                  	POP	SI			    ;AN000;;LB.
 31580                                  	POP	DS			    ;AN000;;LB.
 31581                                  	;JMP	SHORT sc2end		    ;AN000;;LB. return
 31582                                  	; 04/02/2026
 31583                                  sc2end: 				    ;AN000;
 31584                                  	CLC				    ;AN000;;LB. carry clear
 31585                                  sc2end2:	
 31586                                  	retn				    ;AN000;;LB.
 31587                                  
 31588                                  scerror:				    ;AN000;
 31589                                  	MOV	word [ss:CALLSCNT],1	    ;AN000;;LB. reset sector count to 1
 31590                                  	MOV	word [ss:SC_STATUS],0	    ;AN000;;LB. invalidate all SC sectors
 31591                                  	MOV	byte [ss:CurSC_DRIVE],-1    ;AN000;;LB. invalidate drive
 31592                                  	STC				    ;AN000;;LB. carry set
 31593                                  	retn				    ;AN000;;LB.

 31600                                  ;Break	<SC2BUF- move data from SC to buffer>
 31601                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31602                                  ;
 31603                                  ; Procedure Name : SC2BUF
 31604                                  ;
 31605                                  ; Inputs:  [SC_STATUS] = SC validity status
 31606                                  ;	   [SC_SECTOR_SIZE] = request sector size
 31607                                  ;	   [SC_CACHE_PTR] = pointer to SC
 31608                                  ; Function:
 31609                                  ;	   Move data from SC to buffer
 31610                                  ; Output:
 31611                                  ;	   carry clear, in SC  and data is moved
 31612                                  ;	   carry set, not in SC and data is not moved
 31613                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31614                                  
 31615                                  SC2BUF:
 31616                                  	; SS override for all variables used
 31617                                  	CALL	IN_SC			    ;AN000;LB. in secondary cache
 31618                                  	;JC	short noSC		    ;AN000;LB. no
 31619                                  	; 24/09/2023
 31620                                  	jc	short sexit
 31621                                  	MOV	AX,1			    ;AN000;LB. check if valid sector
 31622                                  	SHL	AX,CL			    ;AN000;LB. in the secondary cache
 31623                                  	TEST	[ss:SC_STATUS],AX	    ;AN000;LB.
 31624                                  	JZ	short noSC		    ;AN000;LB. invalid
 31625                                  ;entry SC2BUF2
 31626                                  SC2BUF2:				    ;AN000;
 31627                                  	;MOV	AX,CX			    ;AN000;LB. times index with
 31628                                  	;MUL	word [ss:SC_SECTOR_SIZE]    ;AN000;LB. sector size
 31629                                  	; 24/09/2023
 31630                                  	mov	ax,[ss:SC_SECTOR_SIZE]
 31631                                  	xchg	ax,cx ; cx = [ss:SC_SECTOR_SIZE]
 31632                                  	mul	cx
 31633                                  	ADD	AX,[ss:SC_CACHE_PTR]	    ;AN000;LB. add SC starting addr
 31634                                  	ADC	DX,[ss:SC_CACHE_PTR+2]	    ;AN000;LB.
 31635                                  	MOV	DS,DX			    ;AN000;LB. DS:SI-> SC sector addr
 31636                                  	MOV	SI,AX			    ;AN000;LB.
 31637                                  	MOV	ES,[ss:CALLXAD+2]		    ;AN000;LB. ES:DI-> buffer addr
 31638                                  	MOV	DI,[ss:CALLXAD]		    ;AN000;LB.
 31639                                  	; 24/09/2023
 31640                                  	;MOV	CX,[ss:SC_SECTOR_SIZE]	    ;AN000;LB. count= sector size
 31641                                  	SHR	CX,1			    ;AN000;LB. may use DWORD move for 386
 31642                                  ;entry MOVWORDS
 31643                                  MOVWORDS:				    ;AN000;
 31644                                  	CMP	byte [ss:DDMOVE],0	    ;AN000;LB. 386 ?
 31645                                  	JZ	short nodd		    ;AN000;LB. no
 31646                                  	SHR	CX,1			    ;AN000;LB. words/2
 31647                                  	DB	66H			    ;AN000;LB. use double word move
 31648                                  nodd:
 31649                                  	REP	MOVSW			    ;AN000;LB. move to buffer
 31650                                  	CLC				    ;AN000;LB. clear carry
 31651                                  	retn				    ;AN000;LB. exit
 31652                                  noSC:					    ;AN000;
 31653                                  	STC				    ;AN000;LB. set carry
 31654                                  sexit:					    ;AN000;
 31655                                  	retn				    ;AN000;LB.
 31656
